name: Bridge USDB
collateral: 1:1 USD reserves held in cash and BlackRock money market funds; managed by Bridge (Stripe subsidiary) under conditional OCC national trust bank charter
launchPhaseDetail: USDB powers Stripe's Stablecoin Financial Accounts in 101 countries; 1:1 backed by USD held in cash and BlackRock money market funds; Bridge received conditional OCC national trust bank charter Feb 2026; distinct from Blast's USDB (usdb-blast)

featuredContent.title: Stripe rolls out stablecoin accounts in 101 countries as Bridge launches USDB
featuredContent.description: Bridge's USDB underpins Stripe's global stablecoin financial accounts with 1:1 USD backing via cash and BlackRock MMFs.

milestones.title: Bridge receives conditional OCC national trust bank charter
milestones.description: Approval enables Bridge to custody crypto assets, issue stablecoins, and manage reserves as a federally regulated entity.

milestones.title: USDB launches powering Stripe's Stablecoin Financial Accounts in 101 countries
